title: Attestation Pack pricing experiment and SIG/CAIQ response automation
creator: Marina Ortega
description: Define and validate an "attestation pack" product offering that bundles SIG/CAIQ responses, signed customer attestations, and an automated questionnaire export for enterprise customers. Run a pricing/packaging experiment to determine whether this should be a premium add-on, part of Dedicated, or included in higher enterprise tiers.
background: Multiple enterprise prospects and account execs have requested a more turnkey way to get completed SIG/CAIQ and self-attestation artifacts. Currently, Security and Legal produce bespoke responses per RFP which is slow and costly. Parallel conversations in sales have surfaced willingness to pay for 'attestation-as-product' and also requests to include attestations as part of an SLA-backed plan. We need a repeatable productized approach plus tooling to auto-generate the canonical SIG/CAIQ exports and signed attestations to reduce time-to-closure for contracts.
progress_updates: 2025-11-10: Discovery interviews with three strategic customers; all want downloadable CAIQ + a short attestation letter for procurement. Some requested evidence extracts (eg. proof of encryption keys, retention policies).

2025-12-02: Workshop with Security, Legal, and Solutions Engineering to map which SIG controls we already cover in documentation and which require engineering telemetry. Identified 27 controls needing traceable evidence vs 60 that can be answered from policy docs.

2026-01-12: Prototype attestation bundle (PDF + machine-readable CAIQ JSON) created by Solutions Eng for two customers. Saved ~8 hours of manual work per RFP. Collected feedback: customers want a signed artifact and a console badge indicating "Verified Attestation Pack".

2026-02-05: Pricing experiment design completed: two variants (A: add-on $X/month + one-time attestation fee; B: included at Enterprise tier and Dedicated with higher commit). Experiment gating defined and instrumentation planned in Salesforce and Console billing metrics.
2026-02-18: Legal requested more explicit statements about third-party subprocessor lists; Security to automate subprocessor snapshot from asset inventory before next prototype iteration.
decisions: Scope v1 to: SIG Lite (subset mapped to CAIQ 3.1 core controls), a standardized attestation letter, and a machine-readable CAIQ JSON export. Defer evidence extraction for 2nd release.

Run a 12-week pricing experiment with two cohorts: Sales offers variant A (add-on) to new prospects and variant B (include in Enterprise tier) for three named accounts. Measure conversion and time-to-close.
Expose an "Attestation Pack" checkbox in the Dedicated onboarding flow and create a Console view for customers to download the signed artifacts.
Automation responsibility: Security owns canonical CAIQ answers and periodic review; Engineering (Solutions/Platform) owns the export generator and integration points for evidence metadata.
blockers: Need approved legal language for the attestation letter (Legal/Compliance).
Missing programmatic access to subprocessor snapshots and key rotation logs (Infra/Platform dependency).
Billing team requires a SKU definition and metering plan before pricing experiment can go live.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SIG/CAIQ answer set published in Confluence and linked from the Console.
Automated CAIQ JSON export that can be downloaded by customers (v1: static answers + metadata).
Signed attestation letter template approved by Legal and available for customer download.
Pricing experiment instrumentation live in Salesforce and product telemetry captures offer/accept steps.
Pilot rolled out to at least 3 named enterprise prospects and time-to-close metrics collected.
notes: Goal is to reduce manual RFP turnaround from days to hours and to create a repeatable commercial path for attestation-driven procurement. Post-experiment, evaluate bundling vs add-on economics and effects on churn/landing large accounts.
